account_id.description: The account it posts to: an active posting account, not a money account, receivables or payables.

amount.description: Its signed amount in the line's currency, money in positive. Left out, the rest of the line, for one part at most: a whole line is one part without it.

dimension_value_ids.description: The part's dimension values (listDimensionValues), at most one of each dimension and each in use (DIM-06): its line, and each month a spread releases, carry them. A part a person codes on an account that requires a dimension names a value of it (DIM-05); a rule applied by itself posts without one, and Checks flags the amount (Appendix C.2 #60).

gst_code.description: Its GST code from the sg-gst pack on the line's date; left out, the account's default.

spread_months.description: Months it spreads over from the line's month, as a prepayment or deferred income released monthly (FR-GL-03); 0 for none.
